mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the coil was most worthwhile: it showed how process coolant can transfer heat to stored water without mixing the fluids.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling and insulating the tank were clear but predictable construction steps, with little decision-making once the design was established.

surprise.text: The final result says warmth reaches the room when the warm steel is exposed, rather than describing a separate heat-distribution circuit.

arbitrary.text: The initial tool-and-steel combination was a guess: the goal suggested a tank, but the board did not specify how to make one. The resulting fabrication was physically explained.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the recovered heat is used, although this chapter's largely linear assembly offered few meaningful choices.
